allowedWork: s01: Freeze owner/capability and author-task baseline; pin original problem, preservation URLs and exact commands; reconcile stale delivery summary; risk Low; F: source/ref audit, exact fixture arithmetic, unchanged worktree baseline; one commit.

s02: Add bounded probability source constructors and canonical immutable joint model over existing rational arithmetic; risk Medium; S: malformed JSON/numbers, duplicate IDs, negative/bad totals, exact normalization of representation only, immutability and negative type tests; one commit.

s03: Add typed marginal and conditional query evidence with positive-reference-population capability; risk Medium; S: exact sums/ratios, complement partitions, zero masses, impossible conditioning, forged capability rejection; one commit.

s04: Derive both binary tree orders and explicit construction/collapse/condition/reorder operations with occurrence correspondence; risk High; S: same four joint masses both orders, reachable branch sums, round-trip order, unchanged source identity; one commit.

s05: Bind bounded probability evidence into existing asset/operation/governed construction seams; explicit unsupported cases; risk High; B: law/ref/revision/role closure, forged authority and unknown operation negatives, architecture/import checks; one commit.

s06: Bind tree labels, quantity references and native equation endpoints to the same evidence; declare actual motion capability signatures; risk Medium; S: every displayed value matches exact evidence; native endpoints and named existing evaluation mechanism canary; one commit.

s07: Mount minimal proposed Focus Card with static first frame and existing clock, checkpoint mapping, keyboard, buttons and gestures; risk High; B + V: scoped Chromium smoke for stops/count, continuous intermediate frames, reverse/interruption, no initial duplicate paint; one commit.

s08: Implement one reversible SVG tree choreography and semantic attention packet for all four operations; risk High; S + V: pure sampling, identity/ownership checks, direct seek, smallest contact sheet, narrow and reduced-motion smoke; one commit.

s09: Produce coherent exemplar review packet and runnable URL; commit checkpoint evidence; risk High; V + H: inspect meaning, population change, tracking, cadence, typography, tree/equation handoff and controls; one commit.

s10: Encode accepted motif regressions without globalizing provisional choices; risk Medium; S + V: accepted source/intermediate/target checkpoints, reverse/interrupt, accessible state and stable paint owners; one commit.

s11: Add bounded author draft/checker with both declared input forms, semantic edit diagnostics and unknown-operation gaps; risk Medium; S: valid numeric/label/order/detail edits; malformed/unsupported request repair; no generated geometry or timing authority; one commit.

s12: Apply edits atomically to prepared tree, notation, prose bindings and navigation; retain complete last-valid revision on failure; risk High; B + V: edit-while-playing/gesturing; stale preparation cancellation; outputs/count all update together; failed draft retention; one commit.

s13: Derive full and compact readings through existing Article/projection contracts with mandatory definitions and population context; risk Medium; S: reference closure and same revision/facts in both readings; context cannot be dropped by compression; one commit.

s14: Add one bounded parent/reason/return path and context-preserving extraction for the denominator reasoning; risk Medium; S + V: exact interrupted return, required population/assumption refs, stale/forged revision rejection; one commit.

s15: Add validated revision-pinned URL/history restoration and disposal/bfcache behavior through existing lifecycle mechanisms; risk High; B + V: refresh, Back/Forward, direct jump, source change, untrusted hash, paused resume, listener cleanup; one commit.

s16: Derive prediction and reconstruction prompts from the same conditional query and extraction; preserve explicit answers/context; risk Medium; S: posterior direction, denominator explanation structure, answer/revision coherence and no answer leakage before reveal; one commit.

s17: Compile selected Bayes source into existing publication artifact envelope with static SVG/native math/full context; risk High; B: exact source/output pins, reproducible no-JS content, escaping, no interactive/editor imports, existing edition preservation; one commit.

s18: Join applied-source download, immutable edition creation and verification; reject stale draft publication; risk High; B + V: edit/export/build/open/rebuild selected revision, invalid draft exports last-valid source, no overwritten prior editions; one commit.

s19: Add a second original binary problem primarily as source: opposite posterior direction and asymmetric joint masses; risk Medium; S + V: exact second answer, same operation/renderer/input paths, changed labels/order/numbers, zero new timeline implementation; one commit.

s20: Pressure conditional support boundaries with zero cells, unreachable branches, equal likelihoods, complements and bounded exact-number stress; risk Medium; S: property/table tests, undefined-parent omission vs typed gap, source order permutations, input size limits; one commit.

s21: Measure both callers and extract only duplicated mechanical plumbing demonstrated by them, within probability; risk Medium; B: both unchanged outputs, actual inference/import costs, source-only second-caller edits, removal of superseded local glue; one commit.

s22: Publish bounded human/LLM packet and run one actual generation-plus-repair trial through existing access; risk Medium; S: held-out valid/invalid cases; request fulfillment distinct from compilation; exact captured source/diagnostics; at most two model calls; one commit.

s23: Profile multi-card mounting, inactive work, source preparation and frame cost; repair owning seams within fixed budgets; risk High; B + V: deterministic performance harness, idle/offscreen suspension, bounded layout reads/caches, accepted R2/tax preservation; one commit.

s24: Run responsive/theme/accessibility and supported-browser integration cohort after accepted two-caller treatment; risk High; B + V: Chromium/Firefox/WebKit, keyboard/wheel/drag, forward/back settlement, reduced motion, light/dark, narrow, static reading; one commit.

s25: Run broad release gates and fix attributable failures without weakening gates; risk High; B: full tests/typecheck/build, architecture/inference and unchanged reader budgets, R1/R2/tax preservation, Theseus validation; one commit.

s26: Record costs, author-task outcomes, capability limits and R4 handoff; close receipts/target/contract and commit closeout; risk Low; F: evidence links/actual counts, no open receipts, clean scoped worktree and final durable progress; one commit.
Brief tracked context; fixed budgets; no agents; existing clock card and semantic owners; proposal preservation boundary and done contract.
disallowedWork: s01 STOP: Conflicting active authority or required capability outside this envelope
s02 STOP: Needs general event algebra or a second arithmetic owner
s03 STOP: Undefined conditional would be represented as a number
s04 STOP: Branch order becomes truth or causation authority
s05 STOP: Requires bypassing governance or a universal operation schema
s06 STOP: Needed new compositor mechanism exceeds bounded reuse
s07 STOP: Second clock, private input policy or accepted-card regression
s08 STOP: Unresolved correspondence or motion requires unrelated generic fallback
s09 STOP: Mandatory HUMAN_CHECKPOINT before slice 10 until accepted
s10 STOP: Requested visual revision changes accepted treatment
s11 STOP: Arbitrary probability language or parser inference is needed
s12 STOP: One projection changes revision independently
s13 STOP: Requires new universal Article grammar
s14 STOP: Probability evidence forced through equation-specific binder
s15 STOP: Needs remote persistence, hidden revision store or replay-to-restore
s16 STOP: Claims automated grading of unrestricted explanatory prose
s17 STOP: New publication authority or public delivery mutation required
s18 STOP: Browser gains filesystem writes or old distributed bytes are mutated
s19 STOP: New topology or aesthetic treatment required; request bounded review before it
s20 STOP: Scope expands into arbitrary multi-event trees or approximate inference
s21 STOP: Universal renderer/public API proposal needed or fixed budget cannot be met
s22 STOP: No existing access or new paid/account authority needed; report missing live evidence honestly
s23 STOP: Requires budget waiver, renderer rewrite or unreviewed choreography
s24 STOP: Material new visual judgment needed; physical-device behavior remains qualified
s25 STOP: Unrelated repair, unsafe operation or architectural expansion needed
s26 STOP: Any required slice or proof remains incomplete
No universal schema CAS extra domains renderer rewrite accounts browser writes spending merge deployment budget waiver or automatic R4.
goal: Exact authored probability drives tree equations reading retrieval and publication with a second original caller.
commitCadence: One verified independently reversible slice and Theseus evidence per commit; no merge.
stopConditions: Mandatory human visual approval after s09 before s10.
Stop for material new visual judgment, scope expansion, unsafe authority, unavailable required evidence, user pause or completed scope. Repair routine failures without budget waivers.
